ITR-4 Validation Rule #1
Category: D (Advisory - Claim may not be allowed)

1. Under Salary, assessee has claimed Income claimed for relief from taxation u/s 89A without furnishing of Form 10EE.

ITR-4 Validation Rule #2
Category: D (Advisory - Claim may not be allowed)

2. Under Income from Other Sources, assessee has claimed Income claimed for relief from taxation u/s 89A without furnishing of Form 10EE.

ITR-4 Validation Rule #3
Category: D (Advisory - Claim may not be allowed)

3. The assessee has claimed relief u/s 89(1) without furnishing of Form 10E

ITR-4 Validation Rule #4
Category: D (Advisory - Claim may not be allowed)

4. Deduction u/s 80GG shall be claimed for the period of stay for which the rent is actually paid, i.e., 5000 per month
